rules.CONTRACT_SHAPE: The contract has exactly the declared envelope, node, edge, gate, state and artifact fields, with well-formed values (directive section 7).
rules.NO_VENDOR_LOCK_IN: No vendor-, framework-, provider- or model-specific construct appears anywhere in the contract (directive sections 5 and 9).
rules.NODE_KIND: Every node is one of AGENT_TASK, DETERMINISTIC_TASK, ROUTER, HITL_GATE, VERIFICATION_GATE, SUBGRAPH (directive section 7).
rules.UNIQUE_IDS: Node, transition and artifact identifiers are unique within their table.
rules.TYPED_IO: Every node declares a framework-neutral input_schema and output_schema, and every edge carries a value its target's input_schema accepts (directive section 7).
rules.NO_DANGLING_ROUTES: The entry, every edge endpoint and every route-map target name a declared node.
rules.DECLARED_REFERENCES: Gate guards, state transitions and artifact producers name declared nodes; a subgraph does not reference its own graph.
rules.NO_SELF_SATISFIED_GATES: No gate routes into itself, guards itself, or is satisfied by anyone but its external principal; no gates satisfy each other (directive section 9).
rules.SELF_CHECK_NEVER_EQUALS_INDEPENDENT_REVI: A verification gate requires exact-head, session-independent review completed as REVIEW_COMPLETED (directive sections 8.5 and 9).
rules.HITL_BOUNDARY: A HITL gate names one of the consequential boundaries listed in the gate-criteria table (directive section 8.6).
rules.DETERMINISTIC_ROUTING: Conditional edges leave routers only; a router has exactly one total, typed route-map; any other node has at most one static successor (directive section 7).
rules.REACHABILITY: Every node is reachable from the entry and the graph has at least one terminal node.
rules.STATE_VIA_TRANSITIONS: State is scoped, held by the control plane, and written only through declared, typed transitions (directive section 7).
rules.ARTIFACTS_ARE_EVIDENCE: Artifacts are versioned evidence; no artifact is a state store, a state key or a transition target (directive section 7).
